displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists Whisper in the Speech area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision”. The page names Alec Radford, Jong Wook Kim, Ilya Sutskever as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
displayDescription.zh:
BenchCouncil 在 AI100（2022-2023）年度表的“语音”领域列出 Whisper。该条目关联论文《Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision》。页面把 亚历克·拉德福德、Jong Wook Kim（官方页拼写）、伊利亚·苏茨克维 列为主要人物。

本 Archive 记录保留官方行序、引用数、机构和国家字段。它表示 2022-2023 年度入选记录，与长期 canonical AI100 故事线分开维护。
